doc.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

chapter: Jelly Roll Morton in Chicago and early sightings
title: First seeing Jelly Roll at Pete Lala's and playing house parties with Steve Lewis
summary: Zutty remembers first seeing Jelly Roll in New Orleans at Pete Lala's, before he was professional, when he played private party jobs on drums with pianist Steve Lewis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

that's the first time I remember seeing Jelly Roll, that night in Pete Lala's camera. Old Faith Mavis. That's the first time I'd seen Faith before I heard it. Steve, I knew it. I knew it. Just who he was.

No, I was just playing with Steve. This drum and piano. We'd get no party jobs, you know, home jobs, you know, different moves. Private parties and things like that. That's before I really was professional. Steve Lewis was a piano player. He played with the old P-Rong player.
